blocks.text: Logitech MK540 Advanced Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo Logitech MK540 Advanced is a wireless full-size keyboard and mouse combo built for precision, comfort, and reliability. Enjoy the plug and play wireless freedom of the combo, with the tiny USB receiver equipped with Logitech Unifying technology. The keyboard is spill-resistant (1) and abrasion-resistant key printing ensures your keys won’t quickly fade. The keys have been optimized for improved accuracy and reduced noise. The palm rest and adjustable tilt legs keep you comfortable for long stretches at the desk. With convenient and essential hotkeys for direct access, as well as preset Fn keys that can be personalized in Logitech Options. The contoured wireless mouse is designed to fit in either your right or left hand and features enhanced tracking, precise cursor control that keeps you in command. Keyboard Product Details: Dimensions: 7.62 x 18 x 0.94 in Weight: 28.4 oz Adjustable Keyboard Height: 3 tilt positions Special Keys: Music controls, programmable keys 10-Key Number pad Palm rest Key Type: Deep profile Caps lock indicator light On/off power switch 2 AAA batteries（Alkaline Battery） Battery life: 36 months Mouse Product Details: Dimensions: 2.43 x 1.54 x 0.45 in Weight: 2.59 oz Sensor technology: Smooth Optical tracking Number of buttons: 3 (Left/Right-click, Middle-click) Scrolling: line-by-line Scroll Wheel: 2D, optical Connect/Power: On/Off power button 1 AA battery（Alkaline Battery） Battery life: 18 months Wireless Range: Up to 33 ft (2) Compatible on Windows 7, 8, 10 or later, Chrome OS (1) Tested under limited conditions (maximum of 60 ml liquid spillage). Do not immerse keyboard in liquid. (2) Wireless range may vary based on user, environmental and computing conditions. (3) Keyboard and mouse battery life may vary based on user and computing conditions.

items.label: Precision Typing
items.value: An instantly familiar experience, type with ease and comfort on this full-size wireless keyboard, featuring reduced noise, palm rest, spill-resistant design (1), adjustable tilt legs

items.label: Built For Comfort
items.value: The sleek combo's wireless mouse features an ambidextrous shape and soft rubber side grips that fit comfortably in your palm, as well as enhanced tracking and precise cursor control

items.label: Long-Lasting Autonomy
items.value: The wireless keyboard and mouse set come with long-lasting battery life, with the keyboard lasting up to 36 months and the wireless mouse for up to 18 months (3)

items.label: Customized Control
items.value: Enhanced productivity at your fingertips, the computer keyboard comes built with convenient, essential hotkeys providing direct access to media, calculator, battery check functions

items.label: Wireless Freedom
items.value: Plug-and-play your keyboard and mouse with the mini Logitech Unifying USB receiver, for a reliable wireless connection up to 33 ft away from your PC or laptop (2)

items.label: Compatibility
items.value: This Logitech mouse keyboard combo is compatible with Windows 10 or later, Windows 8, Windows 7, Chrome OS

items.label: Upgrade to Logitech MK850 Combo
items.value: Improve productivity with the multi-device MK850 Keyboard and Mouse Combo, with Bluetooth/USB, padded palm rest, sculpted mouse, hyper-fast scrolling, customization

items: In case of wireless keyboard or combo (keyboard and mouse), the USB receiver is usually provided either inside the mouse (under the battery cover) or attached within the product packaging
